What started out as a cut-rate vacation turns into an examination of the common problems many face.

The only way he can make it is to become a gigolo himself, taking on an unusual mix of female clients. He encounters a couple of problems, though. He falls in love with one of his unusual clients, and a sleazy police officer is hot on his trail.
items.title: Deuce Bigalow: Male Gigolo
